name: har-trace-viewer
description: Generate a self-contained HTML performance report from HAR and Chrome trace files

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && npm --prefix ../web run build && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --jsx=automatic --external:ink --external:react --define:__HTV_VERSION__="$(node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./package.json').version)")" --outfile=dist/index.js && mkdir -p dist/web && cp -R ../web/dist/. dist/web
